constraints: Plan only; this invocation authorizes no implementation.

verificationStrategy.independence: No reviewer may have implemented or previously reviewed the same work; the final verdict is signed by an agent distinct from all implementers and per-task reviewers.
tiers: Per task: the task's single positive acceptance signal, then an independent adversarial reviewer re-runs it and attempts falsification.
Per group: the full gate subset for the touched area.
Whole plan: the independent completeness verdict + make check + make test + regen; then CI green for the pushed SHA.
